Changes

Updated the SQA-18 test-case status and evidence records.

Added five independent Chrome browser performance measurements.

Recorded a median visual-readiness time of 199.5 ms and maximum of 257.9 ms.

Verified dashboard statistics, severity distribution, styling, and visual readiness.

Included Playwright automation tools, screenshots, performance traces, and testing documentation.

Test Results

SQA-18 passed against the documented operational acceptance criterion of under 2,000 ms.

Limitations

Testing was performed on an isolated local development instance. Formal approval of NFR-PERF-01 remains pending.

structuredContent.display_title: QA: SQA-19 Human Usability and SQA-20 Browser Accessibility Testing

structuredContent.body:
Records Shirui's explicit observer approval of EILMAR-P01's five SQA-19 interpretations and supporting explanations from the 19 October 2026 session. SQA-19 is now PASS — observer approved (5/5), while the original submitted observation sheet remains unchanged. The wording assistance, absent unpolished answers/session screenshot and uncorroborated aspects of the unaided session remain disclosed; no signature or precise approval timestamp is inferred.

Recalculates the master register to 22 planned, 16 executed, 16 PASS, 0 provisional PASS, 0 FAIL/BLOCKED and 6 NOT RUN (72.73% execution; 100% pass among executed master cases). SQA-18's proposed-criterion PASS and SQA-20's automated-retest PASS remain unchanged, with original SQA-20 FAIL evidence preserved.

Includes a technical assessment of PM-VALIDATION-01 for a separate application branch/PR. `ModelState.Clear()` removes malformed numeric-input binding errors, allowing default status 200 to persist. The existing HTTP regression remains 28 PASS / 1 FAIL; no application correction or teammate assignment is made here.

Validation:
- 20/20 automated documentation checks PASS.
- 151 local links resolve across 11 documents; CSV schema, widths, IDs, totals and approval records checked.
- 1,577 pre-existing evidence files compared; only the two intended current SQA-19 documents changed. Original observations and SQA-18/SQA-20 artifacts are preserved.
- Documentation-only diff; no fresh local .NET/browser/HTTP execution claimed. Existing 136/136 .NET evidence remains historical; GitHub Actions runs separately for this PR.

Evidence: [SQA-19 final assessment](https://github.com/3ilmar/apiguard/blob/ca4a49713e9501b2b6194897012b9473c8a8ca2c/docs/qa-evidence/SQA-19/observer-assessment-session-eilmar.md), [validation](https://github.com/3ilmar/apiguard/blob/ca4a49713e9501b2b6194897012b9473c8a8ca2c/docs/qa-evidence/SQA-19/final-approval-20261019/validation.json), [numeric defect assessment](https://github.com/3ilmar/apiguard/blob/ca4a49713e9501b2b6194897012b9473c8a8ca2c/docs/qa-evidence/SQA-19/numeric-endpoint-validation-assessment.md).

Remaining submission work: six NOT RUN acceptance cases, RTM/requirement coordination, formal performance-criterion approval, PM-VALIDATION-01 and DEF-010 triage/correction, and the team's release decision. This PR does not establish full WCAG compliance or human accessibility acceptance.

Post-submission CI: both push workflows and both PR workflows passed. PR runs: [.NET quality checks](https://github.com/3ilmar/apiguard/actions/runs/39238655229) and [ENSE707 Quality Gate](https://github.com/3ilmar/apiguard/actions/runs/39238655356). The branch-push .NET log records 136/136 tests passing and Release build 0 warnings/errors; no failed workflow was observed.
